basic_info.description: Sophisticated City Living at Millennium Tower. Experience elevated urban living in one of San Francisco's most prestigious addresses  The Millennium Tower. This exquisitely appointed 2-bedroom, 2-bath Grand Residence offers sweeping views from the vibrant city skyline to the serene western hills. Perched on the 34th floor, Residence 34F features refined finishes, expansive windows, and an open floor plan designed for both comfort and elegance. Upgrades include flush wall mounted flat screen TV, custom recessed lighting, stylish custom office nook and designer window coverings throughout.  Also a huge storage area and laundry room featuring full sized W/D. The home is complemented by world-class amenities and impeccable service, delivering a truly resort-style living experience.  Exclusive Club Level Amenities Include: 24/7 concierge & valet parking, Indoor saline pool  5,000 sq. ft. fitness center, Private wine cellar & tasting room, Screening room & lounge, Outdoor terrace and dining room for entertaining.  Whether hosting guests or enjoying quiet luxury, this is San Francisco living at its finest.  Live the Millennium lifestyle  where comfort, style, and service meet. Residence images are virtually staged.
